name: pricing-table
title: Pricing table
description: Two to four plans side by side, each with a name, price, billing period, feature list and one action; an optional billing-period switch above.

frame.summary: Plans are widgets — comparable, each with its own action — which is what CLAUDE.md reserves Card for. The detailed feature comparison below the plans is a table.

regions.name: intro
regions.purpose: Heading, lede, and the billing-period SegmentedControl.

regions.name: plans

budget.wide: one track per plan, up to 4

regions.collapse: auto-fill; the recommended plan keeps its source position (no reordering), so a stacked list reads in the same order as the row.

regions.name: comparison

budget.narrow: fill, horizontal scroll inside the table

regions.collapse: The table scrolls in its own box; the page never scrolls sideways.

components.name: heading
components.for: Section heading and each plan name.

components.name: badge
components.for: "Most popular" marker on the recommended plan.

components.name: icon
components.for: Check marks in feature rows (decorative; the row text says what is included).

components.name: button
components.for: Plan action when it opens a checkout flow in place.

components.name: link
components.for: Plan action when it navigates to sign-up.

dependsOnFuture.for: The feature rows inside a plan.
dependsOnFuture.interim: A plain <ul> styled only with stack tokens.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the section heading; everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

periods.summary: Billing periods for the switch; omit for a single period.

plans.type: Array<{ name: string; price: Record<string, ReactNode>; description?: ReactNode; features: ReactNode[]; action: { label: string; href: string }; recommended?: boolean }>
dont: More than four. A fifth plan is an enterprise link under the table.

comparison.type: Array<{ feature: string; values: Record<string, ReactNode> }>

behavior.summary: The only state is the selected billing period, owned by SegmentedControl; switching it swaps the price text in every plan.

decisions.decision: The period switch is a SegmentedControl, not Tabs
decisions.why: Tabs would imply separate panels; here the same plans stay put and only their price changes, which is a value selection.

decisions.decision: The recommended plan is marked with a Badge and stays in source order
decisions.why: Visual reordering on narrow screens makes reading order and visual order disagree, and raising one card with elevation implies it floats.
A screen-reader user who toggles yearly needs to hear that prices changed; a polite live region on the price group does it without stealing focus.

landmarks.label: aria-labelledby the block's own heading (the section heading)

obligations: Each plan action's accessible name must include the plan ("Start Pro", not "Start") — several identical link names in a row are indistinguishable in a links list.
Prices include the period in text, not just via the switch's state.

steps.change: Plans stack; comparison table scrolls inside its own box.

native.reason: Website-only by decision B3 (gate-1 review, docs/decisions/2026-11-gate-1-review.md): marketing blocks and templates ship on the web only and get no native version. Native in-app purchase screens are governed by App Store / Play billing rules and native paywall patterns; a website pricing table does not map onto them.

tokens.price type: Heading role display-3 (as text, not a heading element)

tokenGaps.need: A page content max-inline-size (container width) for marketing bands
tokenGaps.interim: The band's content box is capped at calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 32) and centred with auto inline margins; the playground's own column cap is a literal with a comment saying there is no measure token. The container max-width token is sent to the design-tokens interview (gate-1 review); this multiplier is the interim until it lands.

tokenGaps.need: A section-band vertical padding step larger than space.section for marketing rhythm
tokenGaps.interim: padding-block uses var(--rata-space-section) top and bottom. space.section is the only page-rhythm step and was sized for docs pages, not full-bleed marketing bands.

tokenGaps.need: A grid gutter role (column and row gap between tiles)
tokenGaps.interim: gap: var(--rata-space-gap-lg) between tiles, var(--rata-space-stack-lg) between rows when they wrap. space.gap.* is documented for inline items, not grid gutters.

openQuestions: Is the comparison table part of this block or a separate block? It is optional here to avoid a sixth block.
